artboards.title: A quiet day, and an unloaded firm

annotations.text:
The change is attribution, not layout.

The panels are the same records. What is new is that each one comes from a named colleague you can go and ask — which is what having thirty-one employees should feel like.

The brief moves to the top and is the only thing on the page actually written by a model. Everything else is assembled from records by a query, and the byline names whose area it is rather than claiming authorship.

The empty state is the design problem that matters most.

Twelve panels reading "Nothing here." is what made production feel broken — it was empty, not faulty. A colleague reporting nothing is a different message from a blank box, and an unloaded firm should say so and offer the way out.
